derivation_lease.name: derivation_lease
derivation_lease.value: ("derivation_jobs"."status" = 'running' AND "derivation_jobs"."lease_token" IS NOT NULL AND "derivation_jobs"."lease_until" IS NOT NULL) OR ("derivation_jobs"."status" <> 'running' AND "derivation_jobs"."lease_token" IS NULL AND "derivation_jobs"."lease_until" IS NULL)

model_approval_record.name: model_approval_record
model_approval_record.value: "model_artifacts"."approval_status" <> 'approved' OR ("model_artifacts"."approved_by" IS NOT NULL AND "model_artifacts"."approved_at" IS NOT NULL)

model_origin.name: model_origin
model_origin.value: ("model_artifacts"."origin" = 'trained' AND "model_artifacts"."training_run_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("model_artifacts"."origin" = 'bundled' AND "model_artifacts"."training_run_id" IS NULL)

publication_origin.name: publication_origin
publication_origin.value: ("observation_publications"."origin" = 'collection' AND "observation_publications"."job_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("observation_publications"."origin" = 'baseline' AND "observation_publications"."job_id" IS NULL)

point_status_score.name: point_status_score
point_status_score.value: ("point_assessments"."status" = 'scored' AND "point_assessments"."score" IS NOT NULL AND "point_assessments"."score" BETWEEN 0 AND 100) OR ("point_assessments"."status" = 'unsupported' AND "point_assessments"."score" IS NULL AND "point_assessments"."reason_code" IS NOT NULL)

prediction_status_score.name: prediction_status_score
prediction_status_score.value: ("prediction_results"."status" = 'scored' AND "prediction_results"."score" IS NOT NULL AND "prediction_results"."score" BETWEEN 0 AND 100) OR ("prediction_results"."status" = 'unsupported' AND "prediction_results"."score" IS NULL AND "prediction_results"."reason_code" IS NOT NULL)

target_kind_horizon.name: target_kind_horizon
target_kind_horizon.value: ("target_definitions"."kind" = 'rule_index' AND "target_definitions"."horizon_seconds" IS NULL) OR ("target_definitions"."kind" = 'future_observation' AND "target_definitions"."horizon_seconds" > 0 AND "target_definitions"."horizon_seconds" IS NOT NULL)

training_success.name: training_success
training_success.value: "training_runs"."status" <> 'succeeded' OR ("training_runs"."metrics_json" IS NOT NULL AND "training_runs"."baseline_metrics_json" IS NOT NULL AND "training_runs"."finished_at" IS NOT NULL)
